English:
June 7, 1985 - OK - we'll try that again. Back to the border zone.

We shouldn't have gone in earlier, the place was just too well-defended. But there was a group of guys in dark outfits lurking around last night - Special Ops, obviously; you could tell by their attitude. And there was a load of explosions over by the pass later on, so it sounds like they've gone in and given those Russkies a good seeing-to. Hopefully, then, things will go better for us this time.

Head South, keeping formation with the platoon leader. He'll spearhead the attack and control the supporting grenadiers and infantry. Further supporting the attack will be Zulu Squad, comprised of an ambulance, repair truck and an M113 infantry carrier.
Clear the pass and liberate Lolisse.

Lieutenant Hammer, now that a path has been cleared through the valley, our tanks can roll forward. You'll be tackling the remaining enemy forces in the pass before pushing on to the village of Lolisse.

You'll start out near Houdan.
Y组一号命令所有Y组队员，子弹上膛，做好战斗准备。很可能先与步兵交火，小心点，完毕。
我是Y组一号，开火！掷弹兵，发射！步兵，在后面掩护！
组一号报告总部Papa Bear，目标完成，Lolisse处所有敌人均以被我军歼灭。等待进一步指示。
Papa Bear呼叫组一号：情报表明，你部南侧出现来袭敌军，注意，敌人试图反扑！”
Z组呼叫Y组一号，救护车就绪。
Y组一号呼叫Y组三号，立即撤退，Hammer中尉！
